verdict.rationale: Relay is a business banking platform, so AI flagging of anomalous or out-of-policy transactions is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only adjacent controls: card spend limits, real-time transaction tracking, and multi-step approval rules. Nothing documents AI or automated anomaly or policy-violation detection that flags transactions for review.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI flag anomalous or out-of-policy transactions automatically for review
